messages:
sam: Hey team — quick ask: can we get a late-merge exception for this PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6732 It's a docs fix + package.json patch (0.9.3 -> 0.9.4). No runtime changes. @maya
release-bot: Automated notice — code freeze begins 2026-04-01 16:00 PDT. Exceptions need release lead + one additional approval and a passing smoke test. Log: https://ci.redwood.ai/rel/1945678901
maya: @sam can you confirm there's a changelog entry and that CI is green? If it's truly docs + version bump and tests pass, low risk. Need QA sign-off before I approve.
derek: I opened the PR — I'm the author. Diff is just README and package.json. CI: all checks passed (unit, lint). No code touched. Changelog: not yet, will add a short line under "Unreleased".
li: QA: I can run a quick staging smoke once you cherry-pick to release branch. Heads up: staging deploy window reopens 14:00 PDT. If you can push before that, I can sanity-check web UI and basic inference route.
maya: Sounds fine but follow the exception checklist: add changelog entry, add label `skip-e2e` if you want to avoid full e2e during freeze, and post the exact cherry-pick commands you'll run. Please @mention me when ready.
derek: Will do. Changelog entry added: "docs: clarify batching default in README". Adding label `docs` and `skip-e2e`. Cherry-pick commands I'm planning to run:```bash
git checkout release/v0.9
git fetch origin
git cherry-pick --no-commit abc1234
# verify
git commit -m "chore(release): 0.9.4 docs bump"
git push origin release/v0.9
```
release-bot: Exception request recorded. Waiting for release lead approval. Policy: one release lead + one QA approval required. (Automated)
maya: Reviewed the diff quickly. Low risk. Approving exception pending QA smoke. @li please react here once you've run the smoke and are happy.
li: Ran smoke on staging at 14:12 PDT — sanity all good: health checks OK, basic prompt response looks fine, no obvious telemetry spikes. Marking QA approval now. :white_check_mark:
sam: Thanks — I will queue merge immediately after the cherry-pick lands. Derek, please paste the final PR merge commit sha here once done.
derek: Cherry-pick applied and pushed to release/v0.9. Commit sha: d4f5e6a. PR updated with release notes link.
release-bot: Exception approved by maya and QA at 2026-03-30T20:10Z. Merged to release/v0.9 by sam at 14:20 PDT. (Auto-log)
maya: Go-ahead confirmed. Please add the PR link to the release notes section and close this thread when done. :tada:
sam: Done — release notes updated. Closing loop. Thanks everyone! :pray:
